title: Story premise ENT102: The Robot Who Collected Exceptions
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (fantasy and science fiction). Hook: This shape is not in my instructions. Takeaway/theme: A useful system can make room for things outside its first categories.
description: A tidy robot wants to sort every object into square or round boxes, but a teardrop-shaped keepsake fits neither rule. Instead of cutting it to fit, the robot adds an EXCEPTIONS shelf, then finds that the shelf holds the most interesting objects in the room and gives each a small name tag.
